notes: Independent review REV-PAPER-LI-LIU-21 (#1116) by Claude Code, session cc-58621d, 30 September 2026. The extraction is by cc-fb70e5, and this session wrote none of the files reviewed. As the maintainer asked on #1116, it continues from the merged checkpoint (ChatGPT, #2841) and settles E3. It reuses the closed full review on branch cc-7b31c4-rev-liliu (PR #2844) where that review held up. Both texts were re-read at every locator: the authors' final version and arXiv v5, whose hashes match the record. Rendered pages were used where glyphs matter (pp.5, 12, 20, 30, 44 and 52). The Li–Zhang, Li–Rapoport–Zhang and Disegni–Liu texts were read at the cited places. Verdict: accept, with the extraction corrected in place. The corrections are: (1) Items. 44 items were corrected and 4 split off (82–83 from 14, 84 from 26, 85 from 29). Items 72, 75, 76, 77 and 78 were marked planned but are now missing, because no layer plans them as stated. The planned lists of items 12 (MP.4), 29 (V2) and 71 (MC.2) were extended. The E10 correction is propagated to items 51, 53, 55, 58, 59 and 63, and the u̲ notation to items 44, 45, 57 and 59. The count is now 85 items: 9 planned and 76 missing. (2) sourceIssues. E1–E11 are confirmed, with corrections to E1 (known), E3, E6 (four places, not three), E7 (⩽ for =; the union is not a fundamental domain), E9 (𝒳, locators), E10 (affects a stated result; verbatim quotes; §11) and E11 (quotes, locators). E3 is settled: every use of Li–Zhang Conjecture 10.4.1 in their §§10.4–10.5 is supplied by Li–Rapoport–Zhang Theorem 14.6.2 with Corollary 16.1.5. So E3 now affects the proof, not a stated result, and stays new. Nine new issues were added, E12–E20. E12 (error): the proofs of Proposition 6.9(2) and Lemma 8.3 claim that restriction to the geometric fibre over a p-adic field is injective on H^{2r}, which is false. E13 (gap): Lemma 8.3's 'by definition' step does not follow from Definition 6.2(2); it is repaired by taking one factor of each Hecke element from (S^R)^0, a change carried into items 48, 56 and 57. E14 (error): the proof of Corollary B.15 claims finite generation over S_L. E15–E18 and E20 are misprints, and E19 is smoothness of X_L at non-neat level. None changes the main theorems. (3) sourceVersions was added, as check_errata requires. (4) Routes. All seven are accepted, with corrected briefs and reasons, and two source routes (8, 9) were added for items 75 and 76.
